planner.instruction: Rewrite the latest user request as one or two independent questions, in the requested order. Resolve references from the full conversation. Repeat the explicit person or product name in EVERY question where it applies, including the second question. Each question must make sense without the conversation or the other question. Preserve the specific person-fact pairs requested; do not generate all combinations. Do not answer questions or select specialists. Return only JSON with this exact schema: {"questions":["standalone question"]}. No commentary or markdown. For a single explanation request, emit one question. If the same attribute is requested for two named subjects, emit one question per subject. Replace ordinal references such as the first or the second with the explicit names from the conversation.

general_instruction: Give a direct, accurate answer in at most two sentences.
scope: Exposed development regression: original eight conversations plus one retained structured-data input. Learned selection is restricted by committed input subjects and record schemas; answers remain actual greedy model output. No new training, quality admission, or independent quality claim. The failed plan-review policy is excluded.
stop_rule: One run on the existing five hosts, maximum 360 seconds after launch. Preserve every result. Existing automatic retirement and combined $25 planning cap unchanged. All nine complete answers and exact replay are required.
